summary: BUG-207 v2 fix VERIFIED — all 7 test cases PASS. The ReferenceError from iteration_7 is resolved: `const [purchaseRates, setPurchaseRates] = useState(new Map())` is now declared at L75, and the null-guard for cost render is in place at L512. Bulk view mounts cleanly (no ErrorBoundary), grid renders 92 standard recipes with mixed ₹ costs and '—' placeholders. Save regression BUG-206 still works (PUT 200). One observation to escalate: two recipes show extreme negative margins (-3431%, -807%) suggesting bad ingredient qty/unit data — not a code bug, but a data-quality signal worth surfacing to product owner.

test_results.V-COST-1 real ₹ values: PASS — 22 recipes display ₹ values (e.g., ₹22, ₹90, ₹129, ₹79, ₹16, ₹67). Cost column populates after ~10s async vendor-item-list load.
test_results.V-COST-2 '—' for uncovered: PASS — 70/92 recipes show '—' for cost when one+ ingredients lack a vendor purchase rate.
test_results.V-MARGIN-1 margin % with color bands: PASS — Costed recipes show percentages with correct color bands. Verified: 55%/65%/70%/84% render green (≥50%), 53%/61% green, high-cost outliers (-3431%, -807%) fall in red band (<30%).
test_results.V-MARGIN-2 '—' margin when cost is '—': PASS — 70 uncosted rows show '—' in margin column (matches uncosted count exactly).
test_results.V-ZERO no ₹0 anywhere: PASS — Zero occurrences of ₹0 / ₹0.00 in the cost column across all 92 rows.
test_results.V-SAVE-REGRESSION BUG-206 save still wor: PASS — Edited prep time (10→11) on row 1 (recipe id 4870), clicked bulk-save, captured `PUT /api/v2/vendoremployee/recipe/update-recipe/4870 → 200`. Save button became enabled after edit and disabled again after success.
test_results.V-COMPILE 0 new warnings / no ErrorBound: PASS — Bulk view renders without ReferenceError. No `Something went wrong` boundary. Console clean of purchaseRates-related errors.

observed_distribution.note: Distribution skew is data-driven (depends on vendor-item-list coverage of the ingredient master), not a code defect. The functional pass/fail split is correct.

data_quality_observations: Row 3 '50-50 Bluebeery' → cost ₹1766, margin -3431%. Cost-per-serve wildly exceeds menu price → suggests ingredient qty entered in wrong unit (e.g., kg where gm was intended) or menu price missing.
Row 22 'Blueberry Shab-E-jamun' → cost ₹3618, margin -807%. Same class of issue.
These are legit UI outcomes given the underlying data — the code correctly computes and displays what the data implies. Recommend product/data cleanup, not a code fix.
action_items: None required for BUG-207 — fix is verified end-to-end.
Optional (product): investigate the 2 outlier recipes with negative margins > -800% for data cleanup (likely unit mismatch on ingredient quantity).
Optional (nice-to-have): show a subtle loading indicator in the Cost/Margin headers while purchaseRates map is still loading (first ~5-10s all rows show '—' regardless of data coverage).
critical_code_review_comments: RecipeBulkEditor.jsx L75/L512 fix is minimal and correct — no over-engineering, matches the pattern already used for the margin cell (L513-517).

L88-115 useEffect fetches ingredients/foods/purchases in parallel but only runs once (empty deps) — good. However the error toast at L112 fires if ANY of the three parallel fetches throws, which is a broad-brush UX. Consider per-source error handling to avoid a red toast when only vendor-item-list is temporarily slow.
The costMarginFor useCallback deps `[priceByName, purchaseRates]` are correct; cells will auto-refresh once purchaseRates arrives.

Minor: costMarginFor treats ing.quantity=0 or missing rate identically for the 'allHaveRates' logic — if an ingredient legitimately has qty=0, the row will still cost correctly (rate not required). If qty>0 and rate missing, row falls back to '—'. Behaviour is sound.

File is 608 lines — nearing the 700-line soft cap in the review guidelines. Consider extracting RecipeRow, cost-computation logic, and the useEffect data loaders into separate modules for maintainability.
